tasks.content: Read docs/how/slices/slice-1-data-foundation/slice.md and docs/how/architecture.md section 'Data Model Implementation'. Implement thoughtModel module with: 1) Thought interface with id, title, content, createdAt, tags properties, 2) createThought(title: string, content: string, tags: string[]): Thought function that generates UUID and timestamp, 3) validateThought(t: any): boolean function that checks required fields. Add unit tests covering UUID generation, immutability, and validation. Use type-safe TypeScript with no any types.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-1-data-foundation/slice.md. Implement colorPalette module with: 1) COLORS constant export as array of 8-12 distinct hex color codes (e.g., ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A', '#98D8C8', '#F7DC6F', '#BB8FCE', '#85C1E2']), 2) ensure WCAG AA contrast compliance for text (black or white) on each background, 3) add comments with color names. No functions needed, just the constant export.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-1-data-foundation/slice.md and docs/how/architecture.md section 'Tag Derivation'. Implement tagModel module with: 1) Tag interface with name and color properties, 2) getTagColor(tagName: string): string function that deterministically hashes tag name to color (same tag → same color always), 3) deriveTags(thoughts: Thought[]): Tag[] function that collects unique tag names and computes colors. Ensure deterministic hash via tagName.charCodeAt(0) % COLORS.length. Add unit tests covering derivation, color assignment consistency, and edge cases. Imports from thoughtModel and colorPalette.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-1-data-foundation/slice.md and docs/how/architecture.md section 'Filter State Management'. Implement filterLogic module with: 1) FilterState interface with optional text, dateStart, dateEnd, selectedTags properties, 2) applyFilters(thoughts: Thought[], filters: FilterState): Thought[] that combines filters with AND logic, 3) matchesTextSearch(thought: Thought, query: string): boolean with case-insensitive substring matching on title OR content, 4) matchesDateRange(thought: Thought, start: number | null, end: number | null): boolean with inclusive bounds, 5) matchesTags(thought: Thought, selectedTags: string[]): boolean with OR logic. Add comprehensive unit tests for each function and edge cases.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-1-data-foundation/slice.md and docs/how/architecture.md sections 'State Management' and 'LocalStorage Schema'. Implement useThoughts React hook that: 1) initializes state with thoughts array from localStorage key 'monjournal_thoughts' on mount (or empty array if missing), 2) validates loaded data via validateThought() from thoughtModel, 3) returns object { thoughts: Thought[], addThought(t: Thought): void, getTags(): Tag[], getThoughts(): Thought[] }, 4) persists to localStorage whenever addThought is called, 5) handles localStorage unavailable gracefully (log warning, continue with in-memory state), 6) handles corrupted JSON (reset to empty array), 7) uses deriveTags() from tagModel for getTags(). Add integration tests with localStorage mocking. Imports thoughtModel, tagModel.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-2-thought-list-display/slice.md. Implement dateUtils module with: 1) formatDate(timestamp: number, format: 'relative' | 'absolute'): string - relative returns 'X hours ago', 'yesterday', 'X days ago' with humanized output; absolute returns 'June 4, 2026' (locale-aware via Intl.DateTimeFormat), 2) groupThoughtsByDate(thoughts: Thought[]): Map<string, Thought[]> - groups thoughts by creation date (normalized to midnight), dateKey format 'YYYY-MM-DD', sorts thoughts within group by createdAt descending. Add unit tests covering date formatting, grouping, same-day sorting, empty arrays, and edge cases. Imports thoughtModel.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-2-thought-list-display/slice.md. Implement ThoughtCard component that: 1) accepts props thought: Thought, onHighlight?: () => void, 2) displays thought title (bold), content (truncated to ~100 chars with ellipsis), creation date via formatDate() in relative format ('2 hours ago'), 3) renders tags via TagDisplay component (import from parallel tasks), 4) uses AppShell card layout with hover state, 5) optional highlight state (border/background change). Add unit tests with snapshot testing. Imports thoughtModel, dateUtils, and will import TagDisplay from display-and-filter.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-2-thought-list-display/slice.md and slice-3-filtering-search/slice.md. Implement all display and filter components in one file (or split later): 1) TagDisplay component - renders tags as colored chips with getTagColor(), text color based on background brightness, rounded corners, responsive sizing; 2) ThoughtList component - renders array of ThoughtCard sorted by createdAt descending, empty state message, responsive grid layout (mobile: 1 col, desktop: 2 cols), optional highlight state; 3) TimelineView with TimelineGroup - groups thoughts by date using groupThoughtsByDate(), day separators with absolute date format, reverse chronological order, empty state; 4) ViewModeToggle - two buttons/toggle switch ('List' | 'Timeline'), active state highlighted, onChange callback; 5) FilterPanel with DateRangePicker and TagMultiSelect sub-components - text input, date fields, tag checkboxes, surprise button, clear button, onFilterChange callback. Use AppShell design tokens and shadcn/ui primitives. Imports thoughtModel, tagModel, dateUtils, filterLogic. Add component tests for all.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-4-add-thought-form/slice.md. Implement all form components in one file: 1) TagInput controlled component - text input with dropdown, filters suggestions by input (case-insensitive), on Enter adds tag if non-empty/not duplicate, on suggestion click adds tag, clears input after add, prevents empty/duplicate tags; 2) TagList component - renders tags as colored chips with getTagColor(), shows tag name, displays remove button (X) on each chip, calls onRemoveTag() on click, uses inline flex layout. Use AppShell design tokens. Imports tagModel and getTagColor. Add component tests.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-4-add-thought-form/slice.md and slice-1-data-foundation/slice.md. Implement AddThoughtScreen page that: 1) renders form with title input (required), content textarea (required), tag input section (optional), 2) uses useThoughts hook to get suggestions and call addThought(), 3) manages state for title, content, selectedTags, tagInput, validationErrors (debounced input validation), 4) shows inline error messages for empty title/content, 5) on submit calls createThought() and useThoughts.addThought(), displays success message, redirects to home via useNavigate('/'), 6) cancel clears form or navigates back, 7) uses TagInput and TagList components from form-components, 8) responsive form layout. Add integration tests with localStorage mocking. Imports thoughtModel, useThoughts, and form components.

Read docs/how/slices/slice-1-data-foundation/slice.md, slice-2-thought-list-display/slice.md, and slice-3-filtering-search/slice.md. Implement HomeScreen as the main container for MonJournal that: 1) initializes useThoughts hook, 2) manages filterState (text, dateStart, dateEnd, selectedTags) and viewMode ('list'|'timeline') with useState, 3) applies filters via applyFilters() from filterLogic, 4) renders FilterPanel, ViewModeToggle, and conditionally ThoughtList or TimelineView with filtered thoughts, 5) implements onFilterChange handler that updates filterState, 6) implements onSurpriseClick handler that selects random thought from filtered results and highlights it (scroll to/ref), 7) manages highlight state. Use AppShell's responsive layout with Tailwind design tokens. Imports useThoughts, filterLogic, and display components. Add integration tests.

Read docs/how/architecture.md section 'Routing' and apps/appshell/app/src/main.tsx for reference. Update main.tsx to: 1) import HomeScreen from screens/HomeScreen, AddThoughtScreen from screens/AddThoughtScreen, keep AboutScreen, 2) add routes: { path: '/', element: <HomeScreen /> }, { path: '/add', element: <AddThoughtScreen /> }, { path: '/about', element: <AboutScreen /> }, 3) keep AppShell root layout structure (Layout, ErrorBoundary, ThemeToggle), 4) update Header.tsx nav links to Home, Add Thought, About, 5) update index.html title to 'MonJournal — Personal Thought Journal', 6) update package.json name to 'monjournal', 7) verify lazy imports work, 8) test with npm run dev. Do not modify AppLayout, ErrorBoundary, or frozen files.
